<p align="center"><strong>Ending 04 of 06 - The Best Company</strong></p>


<p align="center">You step through the gate together. The cat leaps down, walks a few paces, then turns to make absolutely sure you are following.</p>

<p align="center">From the attic, the ghost waves. It has left a tiny saucer on the windowsill for your next visit.</p>

<p align="center">THE BEST COMPANY - Two seals broken, a new friend, and a homeward path. Some treasures follow you out.</p>
